#!/bin/sh
# Nightly backup of /srv/inventory/data from node2 to node1.
# Stores dated tar.gz archives under /var/backups/inventory on node1
# and retains only the last 7 days of archives.
set -e

SRC_DIR=/srv/inventory/data
DEST_HOST=node1
DEST_DIR=/var/backups/inventory
DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
TMP_ARCHIVE="/tmp/inventory-data-${DATE}.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$TMP_ARCHIVE" -C "$SRC_DIR" .

scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o BatchMode=yes \
    "$TMP_ARCHIVE" "root@${DEST_HOST}:${DEST_DIR}/inventory-data-${DATE}.tar.gz"

rm -f "$TMP_ARCHIVE"

ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o BatchMode=yes "root@${DEST_HOST}" \
    "find '${DEST_DIR}' -maxdepth 1 -name 'inventory-data-*.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete"
